questions.questionText: Which statement correctly describes a combinational circuit?
options: Its output can change only after a full clock cycle.
Its output depends only on the present input values.
It requires a clock signal to operate correctly.
It stores previous input values to determine its output.
questions.correctAnswer: Its output depends only on the present input values.
questions.explanation: A combinational circuit produces outputs that are solely a function of the current inputs, with no memory or clocking elements involved. The other options describe characteristics of sequential circuits.
